MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small stainless screws fit my repeated purchases of bolts, rivets and threaded inserts because they support the assembly and repair work I keep returning to.",
    "Flap discs felt like a natural follow-up to my cutting wheels for smoothing cut edges, provided they fit my grinder. Brass rods also offer material for custom pins and fittings alongside my drilling supplies.",
    "Gloves and cuttable foam fit supporting tasks around my projects: handling messy adhesives with suitable protection and cushioning parts or workshop fixtures."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments require a printing setup and project that my purchases have not established; buying fabrication supplies does not mean I currently need 3D printing materials.",
    "The LCD printer resin serves a different process from my tabletop epoxy, and the spray foam gun cleaner requires equipment that my adhesive tape purchases do not establish.",
    "The emergency switch needs a specific electrical control project, which I do not currently have. General repair work alone does not give me a use for it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat many things described as DIY or fabrication supplies as interchangeable, even when they require very different equipment.",
    "Shared words such as resin and adhesive seem to carry too much weight compared with what the material actually does and how I would use it."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener purchases point to ongoing hands-on assembly needs, making practical screws and fitting materials more relevant than supplies for an unestablished printing hobby.",
    "Tool compatibility and the next step in a project matter: finishing a cut edge follows naturally from cutting wheels, while a specialized cleaner or switch needs additional evidence of a use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on repair and fabrication interests but stretched them into specialized equipment and processes I have no established need for."
}
